WwExecution._comment: Configuration for the Warewolf Execution Engine reference client. Replace the GUID/secret placeholders. Secrets should NOT be committed - use user-secrets, environment variables, or Key Vault in real deployments.
WwExecution._resourceAppId_comment: Application (client) ID of the engine's Entra app registration. The engine accepts tokens whose audience is 'api://{ResourceAppId}'.
WwExecution._clientId_comment: Application (client) ID of THIS client's Entra app registration.
WwExecution._clientSecret_comment: Confidential-client secret. Required ONLY for the ClientCredentials (daemon) flow. Leave empty for public-client flows (device-code / interactive / managed-identity).
WwExecution._redirectUri_comment: Redirect URI for the Interactive (browser) flow. Must be registered as a 'Mobile and desktop' / public-client redirect in the client app registration. http://localhost lets MSAL pick a free port.
WwExecution._functionKey_comment: Azure Functions host/function key. Required ONLY for /services/* routes (sent as the x-functions-key header). Optional otherwise.
WwExecution._managedIdentityClientId_comment: Optional user-assigned managed identity client ID. Leave empty to use the system-assigned identity / DefaultAzureCredential default.
WwExecution._cacheFileName_comment: File name for the persistent MSAL token cache (stored in a per-user app-data directory - see README).
WwExecution._sampleWorkflow_comment: Workflow exercised by the demo. URL-unencoded form; the client URI-encodes it.
